faqs.q: What are the eligibility criteria for this program?
faqs.a: This program is exclusively for graduates with a background in Accounting or Finance - B.Com, M.Com, BBA (Finance), MBA (Finance), CA/CMA/CS Intermediate candidates, and ICWA aspirants. A strong interest in corporate finance and accounting is essential. Prior work experience is NOT required.

faqs.q: What is the duration of the program?
faqs.a: The program runs for 2 to 3 months. Weekday batches (Mon-Fri) only. All sessions are live instructor-led with recordings available for revision.

faqs.q: What roles can I apply for after completing the training?
faqs.a: After completing this program, you are eligible for roles such as: AP Analyst, AR Analyst, R2R Accountant, General Ledger Accountant, Finance Analyst, Investment Banking Analyst, KYC/AML Analyst, SAP FI Consultant (End User), Accounts Executive, and more - across MNCs, GCCs, and BFSI firms.

faqs.q: Does SV Professionals guarantee placement?
faqs.a: We have a 95% placement record and a dedicated placement cell that actively connects students with our 50+ hiring partners. We provide resume building, LinkedIn optimisation, mock interviews, referral letters, and exclusive job drives. While we cannot legally guarantee placements, our track record speaks for itself.

faqs.q: Is SAP FI certification included?
faqs.a: The program includes SAP FI End User training with hands-on practice on a live SAP system covering GL, AP, AR, and asset accounting modules. You will receive an SV Professionals completion certificate for SAP FI. Official SAP certification exams are separate and optional - we guide you through the process.

faqs.q: What is covered under Personality Development and Interview Skills?
faqs.a: This module covers English communication for corporate environments, business email writing, presentation skills, body language and grooming, mock HR and technical interviews, group discussion (GD) practice, salary negotiation skills, and LinkedIn personal branding. We conduct multiple full-length mock interview rounds before placement drives.

faqs.q: What is the difference between Accounting modules and Finance modules?
faqs.a: Accounting modules (AP, AR, R2R, P2P, O2C) focus on day-to-day transactional and reporting functions essential for BPO/GCC/shared services roles. Finance modules (Investment Banking, Financial Markets, M&A, AML/KYC) target analyst and advisory roles in banks, NBFCs, and financial services firms. You get training in BOTH - making you versatile across the industry.

faqs.q: Can I join if I am a working professional?
faqs.a: Absolutely. We offer flexible batch timings designed for working professionals who want to upskill and transition into higher-paying finance roles. All sessions are recorded so you never miss a class.

faqs.q: Is the training online or offline?
faqs.a: We offer both modes. Classroom training is available at our Hyderabad centre with hands-on tool access. Online live sessions are available for outstation students with the same curriculum, assignments, and placement support.

faqs.q: Can I join if I'm from a non-HR background?
faqs.a: Absolutely. Our program is designed for ALL graduates - BCom, BA, BSc, B.Tech, BBA, MBA - regardless of your previous field. We start from fundamentals and build you up to job-ready level.

faqs.q: What is the total course fee?
faqs.a: Course fees are competitive and vary by batch and mode (online/offline). We also offer EMI options and early bird discounts. Contact our admissions team for the current fee structure.

faqs.q: Is this program available online or offline?
faqs.a: We offer both classroom training (Hyderabad) and live online classes. Online students also get access to recorded sessions, live doubt-clearing calls, and the same placement support as classroom students.

faqs.q: What kind of placement support is provided?
faqs.a: Our dedicated placement team provides resume building, LinkedIn optimization, mock interviews, company referrals, interview scheduling, and ongoing follow-up until you are placed. We work with 50+ active hiring partners.

faqs.q: What certificate will I receive upon completion?
faqs.a: You will receive an industry-recognized certificate from SV Professionals, acknowledged by our placement partners. It validates your expertise in core HR functions including payroll, recruitment, compliance, and HR operations.

faqs.q: How is this program different from other HR courses?
faqs.a: Unlike theory-heavy programs, every module at SV Professionals includes live projects, real-time case studies, and role plays. Our trainers are working HR professionals, not just academics. Our 2-3 month intensive format is built to make you job-ready fast.

faqs.q: Is Advanced Excel knowledge required before joining?
faqs.a: No prior Excel knowledge is required. Our Advanced Excel for HR module starts from scratch and takes you through all the functions an HR professional needs - payroll sheets, MIS reports, attrition trackers, and dashboards.

faqs.q: What batch timings are available?
faqs.a: We offer morning and evening weekday batches to accommodate working professionals, college students, and job seekers. Batch timings are confirmed at the time of enrollment based on your preference.

faqs.q: Who is this program designed for?
faqs.a: This program is exclusively for graduates with an Accounting & Finance background - B.Com, M.Com, MBA (Finance), BBA (Finance), CA Inter, CMA Inter, or equivalent.

faqs.q: Do I need prior SAP experience?
faqs.a: Absolutely not. We start SAP training from scratch. Our end-user level SAP Fi training is designed for beginners and progressively moves into real-time corporate simulations.

faqs.q: What does "100% Placement Support" mean exactly?
faqs.a: It means we stay with you until you're placed. This includes profile building, resume crafting, interview preparation (technical + HR), and direct connections to our hiring partners.

faqs.q: Is this suitable if I have a career gap?
faqs.a: Yes - in fact, most of our students come with career gaps ranging from 1 to 5 years. Our program specifically addresses how to position your gap positively and present a credible, job-ready profile.

faqs.q: What salary can I expect after the program?
faqs.a: Depending on your experience, location, and the company, our graduates typically secure roles in the ₹3.5-8 LPA range. Entry-level roles start around ₹3.5-5 LPA.

faqs.q: What are the batch timings?
faqs.a: We offer flexible batch timings including weekday morning and evening batches, so working professionals can enroll without disrupting other commitments.

faqs.q: Will I get a certificate after completion?
faqs.a: Yes. Upon successful completion of the program, you will receive an industry-recognised course completion certificate from SV Professionals.

faqs.q: How is this different from online YouTube tutorials?
faqs.a: We offer live, interactive sessions with industry practitioners, access to real SAP systems for hands-on practice, personalised feedback, mock interviews, and an active placement network.
